title: SaaS verification tokens (P342) and WHOIS fallback (P343)
notes: P342 FC3 asks for saas_vendors in core/vocab.py; module batches never edit core files, so it is declared here (decentralised vocabulary, contract v2 s.14) and listed as a core request.

attributes.saas_vendors: SaaS vendors with a domain-verification TXT record at the name (verification record present: proves a past domain verification, not current use; token values stay in evidence only; P342)
attributes.saas_unknown_prefixes: TXT verification-style prefixes that V3LUM's vendor table does not know, listed raw without token values or embedded ids (P342)
attributes.registration_source: protocol that produced the registration data of a WHOIS fallback lookup: rdap | whois (P343)
attributes.registration_server: registry RDAP/WHOIS server that answered a WHOIS fallback lookup (who-dat meta.server, or the port-43 server)
attributes.registration_via: path of the WHOIS fallback that answered: whodat (self-hosted who-dat), whodat_public (public who-dat.as93.net) or whois43 (registry port 43)
attributes.registration_referral: WHOIS referral reported or followed by a WHOIS fallback lookup (at most one hop; registry values win)
attributes.registrar_whois_server: WHOIS server of the sponsoring registrar as published by the registry
attributes.registry_whois_server: WHOIS server of the TLD registry taken from the IANA root zone database (cached 7 days)

tags.saas_footprint: finding lists SaaS vendors with a domain-verification record (ASM inventory and phishing-simulation hints; never a hostile signal)
